items.title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
items.claim: Most LLM-generated trading hypotheses fail pre-registered gates despite strong discovery and validation metrics.

items.title: The Financial Impact of Non-Financial Beliefs in Large Language Models
items.claim: LLM-driven analyst optimism about high-ESG firms lifts target prices but degrades earnings forecast accuracy.

items.title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
items.claim: Alignment tax under length-normalized DPO with SFT retention is task-selective, degrading router performance but sparing extraction.

items.title: The Illusion of Informed Congressional Trading: Evidence from Committee Networks and Hearings
items.claim: Congressional trades aligned with committee assignments produce no abnormal returns before or after hearings.

items.title: One Basket, Many Experts: Decorrelated Re-ranking for Financial Asset Recommendation
items.claim: Replacing a few recommendation slots with decorrelated assets improves risk-adjusted return at small relevance cost after trading costs.
